adopted upstream over Onicode's versioned AppImage name: electron-updater renames a versioned AppImage on every update, breaking launchers and symlinks. Took the desktop half only, adapted: better-update names every AppImage it serves Onicode-<version>[-arch].AppImage whatever electron-builder calls it (and needs the version in the feed URL for blockmaps), so the artifactName change and its test would change nothing users see. Instead, after an updater relaunch, pre-ready setup moves the versioned AppImage to its version-free name (hard link, so it never overwrites) and symlinks the path the update removed there; electron-updater then replaces that file in place.
